test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 09 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
The bar graph given below shows the number of players participating in two games in five different schools L, M, N, P and Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/745682b3d5d06f8790457ede8b969f91ee8b6d7990844cc3681140f9f2f5dd59.png] 

Total number of players participating in game D from all schools is what percentage of the total number of players participating in game E from all schools?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Total number of players participating in game D = 92 + 78 + 66 + 88 + 54 = 378

Total number of players participating in game E = 146 + 102 + 82 + 104 + 96 = 530

Percentage = (Number of players participating in game D from all schools /Total number of players participating in game E from all schools) x 100

Percentage = (378/530) x 100

Percentage = 71.3%

Therefore, the total number of players participating in game D from all schools is 71.3% of the total number of players participating in game E from all schools.

**∴ Option 1 is the correct answer.**
